newsitem.title: UK: Lower UK meals prices fail to attract buyers.
newsitem.headline: Lower UK meals prices fail to attract buyers.

text.p: Lower UK meals and feeds prices on Wednesday failed to excite buyers.
"People are only buying as and when they need to and this situation will remain while Chicago is so volatile," said one broker.
High protein soymeal offers ex-mill where three to five stg down while stores were three stg lower.
Rapemeal, Sunflower meal, sunpellets and corn gluten feed pellets were all unchanged.
The only trade reported was for March rapemeal from Liverpool at 126 stg on the resale market.
